definition: Indian criminal law draws on colonial codification (IPC 1860), post-Independence amendments, and recent replacement statutes (BNS 2023). For exams, trace how general principles of liability and specific offences evolved from common law and statute.

sections: General scheme — compare with IPC where your syllabus requires
statutoryReferences.note: Verify the applicable code for your examination batch

examChecklist.text: Outline milestones from IPC to BNS in brief point form
Distinguish codified offences from common-law origins
